# Jackson Giordano

> Personal website and portfolio of Jackson Giordano, a software engineer in Washington, DC building AI products, RAG systems, and digital experiences.

Jackson is a Virginia Tech Computer Science graduate, an M.S. Software Engineering candidate at the University of Tennessee, and a Junior Software Engineer at eve.ai (via Proven AI). This site covers selected projects, experience, education, and contact details.

Preferred citation name: Jackson Giordano. Contact: jackson@giordano.us. Location: Washington, DC.

## Site

- [Home](https://jacksongio.com/): Portfolio overview with about, experience, selected projects, and contact
- [Resume](https://jacksongio.com/resume.pdf): Downloadable PDF resume
- [Privacy Policy](https://jacksongio.com/privacy-policy): Privacy policy for ArcanAI

## Projects

- [ArcanAI](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/arcanai/id6768841547): Private offline iOS AI assistant running language models on-device with Core ML
- [StudiumVerbi](https://studiumverbi.com/): Catholic study companion using RAG over Scripture, Tradition, and Magisterium
- [The Giordanos](https://thegiordanos.net/): Wedding website with RSVP management, cocktail recommendations, and Spotify song requests
- [FogReport.io](https://fogreport.io/): AI platform for conflict modeling, geopolitics, and RAG-grounded strategic briefings
- [miniZip](https://github.com/Jacksongio/miniZip): Compact ZIP archiver written in C with zlib
- [GioGPT](https://github.com/Jacksongio/GioGPT): Early personal AI assistant with Markdown responses and code generation
